Shotgun Shells only. 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Ablates 2 extra SP (3). Its Critical Injuries roll until three that aren't Foreign Object come up, and the victim takes two of your choice (Bonus Damage from one). Each living target it puts in Mortally Wounded adds +1d6 to its shells for the rest of the fight, up to 7d6; the bonus resets when combat ends or after it fires a 7d6 shell. Without BODY 10+ or paired cyberarms, firing it throws you back 2m with a Broken Arm. Fired downward as a ROF1 Action while jumping or climbing, it moves you 2m any way you like, up included. −2 MOVE while held (min 4).
